title: Austin Governance: Key Board Appointments
summary:
*   The city formally approved dozens of appointments to various civic boards and commissions.
*   These new and reappointed roles covered diverse areas, including historic preservation, parks and recreation, emergency medical services, and the Commission on the Status of Women.
*   The meeting began with a closed executive session before public proceedings commenced and votes were cast.

Mayor McClellan called the Meeting of the Council to order at 4:30 P.M., noting that Mayor
Pro Tem Trevino was absent due to illness. She announced that Council would convene in a
closed or executive session authorized by Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of
Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes annotated; and after such closed or
executive session, any final action, decision or vote with regard to any matter considered
in the closed or executive session would be made in open session, should such action,
decision or vote be necessary. RECESS Council recessed its Council Meeting at 4:31 P.M. to
